summary: The team is juggling urgent IT lockout fixes with a packed marketing push on Asia Start, Intelligent China, and the CKGSB-IE report, while finalizing the knowledge website redesign.
summaryDetail: Right now, the most immediate fire is the Outlook account lockouts affecting multiple devices—everyone must delete and re-login with updated passwords and contact JSB about the backend lock. On the marketing front, the top priorities remain Asia Start and Intelligent China, with Joseph finalizing the Intelligent China webpage and sharing it with Jay and Global Programs, and Julie updating LinkedIn ad assets and the CKGSB-IE report promotion under 'In the News'. This week also demands attention to the knowledge website redesign: Joseph must share the inspiration HTML, and he, Julie, and the speaker need to meet for specific feedback before Joker makes changes. Looking ahead, Joseph needs to confirm the press release with Sun Tianshu, Ira must send the CKGSB-IE report promotion email to Zongchao and share the Prof. Fan Jingting article draft, and the team should prepare for the 2026 Sino-Swiss Economic Forum with Liu Jing's participation.

meetings.title: Knowledge Website Redesign Review
meetings.summary: The team reviewed the proposed knowledge website redesign, comparing it to the current site and Joseph's inspiration layout. They agreed the menu categorization is improved but the overall design is too similar, and decided to combine elements from both versions with further feedback.

meetings.title: CKGSB Global Marketing Strategy Meeting
meetings.summary: The team discussed prioritizing China-based programs (Asia Star and Intelligent China) for SEO and marketing, with a focus on understanding target audience and conversion tracking. They agreed to draft an audit plan and clarify Google Analytics setup.

decisions.text: Remove the videos panel and integrate videos into topics instead of having a separate category.
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge and School) at the top.
Use Joseph's inspiration design as a reference but not follow it exactly; combine elements with the current version.
Bring the BCI index banner into the knowledge section.

Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two marketing priorities.
Consider Berkeley program as a third priority for audit phase.
Put US partnerships on hold for the first quarter.
